QuestInfo.name: Will the Real Olive Please Stand Up
QuestInfo.0: Olive turns into a man and disappears with the jewel. What on Maple is going on?! \r\nThen, Olive walks right up to as if nothing's wrong. Talk to her and make some sense of this!
QuestInfo.1: Olive's upset someone posed as her. \r\nReport the situation to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: Olive's upset someone posed as her. \r\nReport the situation to Athena Pierce.

0.0: Hey, hey! Long time, no see! Guess I oughtta cough up that cup of joe I owe ya, yeah? Not literally, unless you want to save me a couple mesos. \r\n#L0##b(Olive seems clueless about what happened. Guess it's time to fill her in.)#l\n#k
0.1: Say what?! You mistook a me for a MAN?! What are you implying?! \r\n#L0##bYou don't get it. He looked EXACTLY like you! And he took the jewel I was supposed to deliver to Athena Pierce.#l\n#k
0.2: I'm still DEEPLY offended, but I suppose we oughtta talk to #bAthena Pierce#k about that lost jewel.

yes.0: I can't believe you got duped. I thought you were smarter than that. I hope Athena Pierce never gives you another quest again.

no.0: No use crying over stolen jewels. Go and face the music.

1.0: You're back, #h0#! Were you able to retrieve the jewel?

yes.0: I see. It sounds like you've encountered a master of disguise.

npc.0: I'm still DEEPLY offended, but I suppose we oughtta talk to #bAthena Pierce#k about that lost jewel.
